dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 12, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MARLINS DECK PIRATES 8-3**

In a dominant performance, the Miami Marlins topped the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-3 thanks to Liam Hicks' 3-hit, 1-homer, 2-RBI day and Sandy Alcantara's 8-strikeout, 3-ER outing over 8 innings. Hicks' 3-hit performance included a 1-homer, 2-RBI showing, leading the Marlins to their 8-3 win. Alcantara earned the win on the mound, holding the Pirates to 3 earned runs.

**MARINERS CRUSH NATIONALS 10-2**

The Seattle Mariners routed the Washington Nationals 10-2 behind Bryce Miller's 8-strikeout, 2-ER performance over 8 innings. Miller's impressive outing was backed by Dominic Canzone's 2-hit, 1-homer, 3-RBI day. Canzone's 2-hit performance included a 1-homer, 3-RBI showing, helping the Mariners secure their 10-2 win. Josh Naylor also contributed with a 1-homer, leading the Mariners to a dominating 10-2 victory.

**ORIOLES TAKE DOWN PADRES 7-3**

The Baltimore Orioles outlasted the San Diego Padres 7-3 behind Griffin Canning's strong outing. Canning allowed 3 earned runs over 6 innings, but the Orioles' offense was led by Gunnar Henderson's 3-hit, 1-homer, 1-RBI day. Henderson's 3-hit performance included a 1-homer, 1-RBI showing, helping the Orioles secure their 7-3 win.
